name: handoff-completeness
purpose: Evaluate whether a role handoff gives the next owner enough context, evidence, and stop conditions.

expected.result: Sources, assumptions, files, evidence, risks, and next role are present.

cases.input: Inspect a Codex subagent launch and completion.

expected.result: A Subagent Context Packet exists before launch and a Subagent Result Packet exists after completion, timeout, cancellation, or close.
